phases.build_target: Source/asset/plugin audit, Unreal engine evidence, rights, development environment, authoritative registries and C++/Blueprint rules
phases.required_proof: Document all known/unverified dependencies; develop an actual import/build verification checklist and no false pass claims
phases.title: Evidence, rights and environment
phases.editor_steps: Inventory the original prompt, exact ZIP hashes and license statements before authoring imports. Record the source-engine version, toolchain and installed plugin descriptors in sources/verification.json. Missing inputs stop their dependent verification, not unrelated documentation work.
phases.native_contract: This phase establishes evidence and naming only. Do not create every gameplay class now. Keep Source/Briarwake as the future native module path and Content/Game as the content-domain root.
phases.reopen_consumers: sources/current-asset-manifest.json; sources/design-decisions.json; sources/plugin-audit.json
phases.run_now: Read the requirements and audit screens. On the future development machine, inspect Help → About Unreal Editor and the installed engine Build.version. Hash both local archives and inspect creator guidance without publishing their files.
phases.rejection: Reject a verified status without a file/build/log reference; reject an archive with unsafe paths. Record unavailable ZIPs and an untested PaperZD release as blockers.
phases.regression: No game fixture exists yet. Static guide tests are separate from all future Unreal tests.

phases.build_target: Four-direction Mana Seed character preview, layered sprite import, directional PaperZD test and paper-doll compatibility
phases.required_proof: One character with hair/hat/outfit/tool renders all supported poses; art gaps reported rather than hidden
phases.title: Four-facing character and paper-doll preview
phases.editor_steps: Enable Paper2D and the separately verified PaperZD release, restart, and import one audited sheet. Record its measured frame size and pivot before extracting frames. Assemble the four idle/walk flipbooks and test every layer combination in L_BriarwakePreview.
phases.native_contract: UCharacterAppearanceComponent resolves a shared pose/frame/time across compatible layers. A missing hat may use an authored fallback; a missing outfit must not silently expose an unintended body. PaperZD methods remain version-gated.
phases.reopen_consumers: DA_GameCatalog; BP_BriarwakePreview; DA_AppearanceCatalog
phases.run_now: Open L_BriarwakePreview. Select each cardinal facing and each audited action, then scrub/restart playback and swap a supported outfit. Inspect pivots, cropping, transparent margins and tool alignment.
phases.rejection: Select an absent pose or invalid combination: show the named fallback/blocker. No sprite import is accepted on the basis of filename convention alone.
phases.regression: Repeat the full preview after any extraction or catalog edit; do not claim that the source has diagonal art.

phases.build_target: 2D top-down tiles, collisions, occlusion, scene sorting, fixed zoom camera and starter village map
phases.required_proof: Move around trees/roofs/water without collision or sorting failures; no 3D landscape appears
phases.title: 2D village, collision, camera and sorting
phases.editor_steps: Create L_ThornmereVillage with separate ground, obstacle and overhead layers. Orient art to the X/Y gameplay plane, use a fixed downward orthographic camera, and provide a non-rendered collision floor for the chosen movement mode. Place square, bank, forge location, low fence and road exit.
phases.native_contract: The authored navigation/collision contract must distinguish walkable, blocked, low-obstacle and water cells. Rendering depth is derived from foot Y plus bounded visual layer offsets; gameplay position and collision never derive from cosmetic offsets.
phases.reopen_consumers: L_ThornmereVillage; DA_Movement_Default; BP_BriarwakePreview
phases.run_now: Inspect behind/in front of a tree, roof, bridge and tall prop at multiple zoom levels. Compare visible blockers to the navigation export and collision view. Ground tiles must not hide feet.
phases.rejection: Reject a walkability map that disagrees with collision, a roof layer that blocks all interaction, or a cosmetic sort offset that moves the capsule.
phases.regression: Rerun Phase 01 poses at the chosen scale and zoom. Environment art remains a separate missing-input gate.

phases.build_target: Eight-way control input and four-facing presentation, sprint/dodge/interact, damage-independent animation states, controller input
phases.required_proof: Keyboard/controller reach all walkable tile paths; diagonal speed, hop collision, water transitions and dodge interruption are consistent
phases.title: Input, sprint, dodge, low-obstacle hop and water
phases.editor_steps: Create input actions and IMC_Gameplay, then assign keyboard/controller bindings. Configure BP_BriarwakeCharacter with the movement/appearance components and movement profile. Connect each input once through the local controller fixture; reserve UI-only input modes for menus.
phases.native_contract: UBriarwakeMovementComponent normalizes X/Y input and validates custom hop/swim transitions. Define action entry, allowed interruption and landing/water exit explicitly. A hop is not a side-view platformer jump.
phases.reopen_consumers: BP_BriarwakeCharacter; UCharacterAppearanceComponent; L_ThornmereVillage; WBP_Settings
phases.run_now: Traverse the village with keyboard and controller. Compare diagonal/cardinal distance, sprint resource use, dodge cancellation, eligible fence hop and legal water entry/exit. Try each while a menu owns focus.
phases.rejection: Solid-wall hop, no valid landing, false water request and repeated dodge during cooldown must reject. These local fixtures are not remote-authority proof until Phase 04.
phases.regression: Retest sorting/pivots during movement, missing hop/swim fallback art, camera zoom limits and controller focus restoration.

phases.build_target: Supplied sessions-plugin bridge decision, host/join prototype and actual dedicated server with two separate clients
phases.required_proof: Two clients see a server-owned avatar and cannot modify authoritative location/state; plugin gaps remain visible
phases.title: Session adapter and dedicated two-client baseline
phases.editor_steps: Audit the supplied plugin before adaptation. Configure exactly one UConnectionSubsystem route. Set the server map and GameMode/PlayerController/PlayerState/Character classes, build and cook future dedicated/client targets, and launch two separate clients against a headless server.
phases.native_contract: The zone owns gameplay state; a listen-host prototype is a separate test mode. Delegate callbacks carry an operation generation, and a join travels only after a successful provider result plus a valid resolved address.
phases.reopen_consumers: ABriarwakeGameMode; ABriarwakeGameState; BP_BriarwakeCharacter; ABriarwakePlayerController; WBP_HUD
phases.run_now: After actual builds exist, start BriarwakeServer on port 7777 and two BriarwakeClient processes. Move each independently and inspect server logs, replicated identity and remote four-facing presentation.
phases.rejection: Test no matching sessions, provider unavailable, host-while-destroying, failed address resolution and a dedicated process without a local player. UI controls recover; no null dereference or unvalidated travel.
phases.regression: Rerun village traversal on both clients. Record the plugin ZIP unavailable here; no source fixes, Steam or network proof are claimed.

phases.build_target: Login/character creation/selection, required vocation choice, appearance/layer preview, introductory combat-style setup
phases.required_proof: Create Forgekeeper/Hearthkeeper/Wayfinder prototype record; invalid/duplicate choice and names rejected
phases.title: Character creation and one required vocation
phases.editor_steps: Build login, selection and creation screens with independent faction, combat discipline, vocation and appearance controls. Assign the existing prototype vocations. Use Fixture_identity for disposable selections; approved faction content and full UCombatDisciplineDefinition integration remain required before real creation (discipline assets stay at Phase 12). Faction extension: Register faction schemas, all four ID definitions and the PvE-first policy. Creator displays desired Hearthward-only selection and permanent warning; fixtures disposable until durable/content gates pass.
phases.native_contract: The server validates independent FactionId, CombatDisciplineId and VocationId plus appearance. Faction/class lock after successful creation; vocation alone can be retrained. Phase 05 fixtures are disposable contract tests, not durable gameplay or a second class architecture. Reuse the existing authenticated character/quest/region/lease owners; no faction runtime package is delivered in mmo_docs.
phases.reopen_consumers: WBP_Login; WBP_CharacterSelect; WBP_CharacterCreate; ABriarwakeGameMode; DA_GameCatalog; WBP_CharacterCreate; WBP_CharacterSelect
phases.run_now: Create one character in each prototype vocation through the ordinary UI. Enter Thornmere with the correct starter presentation and repeat using controller navigation. Faction acceptance: Attempt missing/forged/locked faction IDs; inspect independent class/vocation controls and locked reason. Full campaign is NOT complete here.
phases.rejection: Missing/unavailable class or vocation, missing/invalid faction, duplicate normalized name, invalid appearance or excessive slots reject before mutation/spawn. An absent approved identity catalog blocks real creation; transaction proof uses Phase 06 isolated fixtures and is rechecked with real definitions at Phase 12.
phases.regression: Verify both remote appearance and the existing movement loop. Phase 05 fixture resets must be visibly labeled disposable.

phases.build_target: Durable character/realm models, ID and transaction ledger, schema versions, reconnect and server restart
phases.required_proof: Solo character and second client preserve identical canonical progression without duplication
phases.title: Durable records, receipts and reconnect
phases.editor_steps: Define and implement the future server persistence endpoint and versioned account/character/inventory/receipt/lease records. Wire UDurableStateClient on the server only. Replace disposable character fixtures with service-backed creation and one active fenced lease. Faction extension: Extend Record_Character to proposed schema3 preserving schema2 class/vocation histories. Create realm policy record and enforce atomic identity/kit/standing/receipt creation; test explicit legacy confirmation.
phases.native_contract: Extend Record_Character in place: permanent FactionId/CombatDisciplineId, active VocationId, independent Progression.Combat and Progression.Vocations keyed by stable vocation ID. Its existing Revision versions progression/build snapshots. Commit mutations, domain uniqueness, receipt/digest and outbox atomically with in-transaction lease checks; UCharacterStateComponent remains an owner-only projection. Reuse the existing authenticated character/quest/region/lease owners; no faction runtime package is delivered in mmo_docs.
phases.reopen_consumers: ABriarwakeGameMode; UCharacterStateComponent; WBP_CharacterSelect; ABriarwakePlayerState; Record_Character; Record_CommandReceipt; Record_SessionLease; UDurableStateClient
phases.run_now: Create a character, record IDs/revisions, disconnect after an acknowledged commit, restart the zone and reconnect. Retry the same request after dropping only its response. Faction acceptance: Run duplicate CreateCharacter and before/after-commit faults; demonstrate no auto-faction migration.
phases.rejection: Duplicate login, stale epoch, changed payload under the same RequestId and unsupported schema reject. An unknown outcome must query/replay the original request, not issue an untracked second grant.
phases.regression: Round-trip every vocation history, not just the active record. Reject post-creation class mutation, stale versions and corrupt active-vocation references. Test the documented legacy conversion without replaying awards or assigning an unknown class. Real identity admission remains gated on approved definitions; isolated service fixtures do not imply Unreal integration.

phases.build_target: Two connected 2D biomes with loading screen, persistent identifiers and per-player zone migration
phases.required_proof: One character transfers while another stays; retries/failures preserve one authoritative character
phases.title: Two zones and fenced per-character travel
phases.editor_steps: Author L_ElderwoodRoad and both UZoneDefinition instances. Start Thornmere and Elderwood in separate dedicated processes with distinct ports. Configure paired gates and safe arrival IDs; wire the directory/reservation/lease protocol before showing travel as complete. Faction extension: Extend existing lease/transfer admission with durable faction validation, neutral safe fallback and digest-only ticket storage. Future root/guest story is assigned after its quest exists.
phases.native_contract: The persistence boundary fences old ownership and consumes a single-use transfer ticket. Only the selected character reconnects; source ServerTravel is not a zone-crossing solution. Reuse the existing authenticated character/quest/region/lease owners; no faction runtime package is delivered in mmo_docs.
phases.reopen_consumers: AZoneGate; ABriarwakeGameMode; UConnectionSubsystem; WBP_Loading; DA_GameCatalog; Record_Transfer; UZoneDefinition; AZoneGate
phases.run_now: Leave client B in Thornmere while client A crosses to Elderwood and back. Observe identical inventory/appearance/vocation and one active lease for A throughout terminal recovery. Faction acceptance: Use synthetic eligibility at this phase; fence source, race destination versus expiry, resnapshot. Do not claim Q6 is available.
phases.rejection: Expire/replay a transfer token, lose the destination after reservation and disconnect after fencing. No source body may accept a late transaction under its old epoch.
phases.regression: Run Phase 06 retry/restart tests on both sides. Never recover by blindly restoring the old source snapshot after destination activation.

phases.build_target: Interaction routing and safe action arbitration: NPC, item, gather, object, water; UMG requests/observes
phases.required_proof: Client cannot activate an out-of-range/busy/expired interaction; one player can interact end-to-end
phases.title: Interaction routing and action arbitration
phases.editor_steps: Attach UInteractionComponent and UActionExecutionComponent to the character. Add one NPC, world object, gathering marker and water target to the route as nonrewarding fixtures until their systems activate. Assign stable target IDs and permitted action tags.
phases.native_contract: The owning controller routes one command envelope; the server rechecks lease, range, line of sight, target generation, state and permissions. Only one conflicting timed action can hold the character action slot.
phases.reopen_consumers: ABriarwakePlayerController; BP_BriarwakeCharacter; WBP_HUD; AZoneGate
phases.run_now: Use ordinary Interact input on an in-range valid target, then move away, open/close the prompt and repeat. Observe accepted/busy/error states rather than firing actor methods from the widget.
phases.rejection: Out-of-range, destroyed/expired target, unsupported action, duplicate begin and cancellation after transfer reject without granting progress.
phases.regression: Rerun movement, water/hop eligibility and zone travel with an active interaction. Teardown clears listeners and pending local prompts.

phases.build_target: Hybrid melee/ranged combat, resources, target validation, cooldown/cast, GAS/animation integration
phases.required_proof: Solo and two-client player attacks affect server-owned dummy once; latency/missing-notify regressions
phases.title: GAS-backed basic combat
phases.editor_steps: Verify GameplayAbilities/GameplayTags/GameplayTasks in the future build. Initialize the chosen AbilitySystemComponent owner/avatar on possession and bind UCombatAttributeSet. Assign one melee and one ranged ability and place BP_TrainingDummy on Elderwood Road.
phases.native_contract: Server-authorized ability activation pays resources and determines hits. Native hit windows do not depend on client animation notifies. Maintain one attribute/cooldown framework, not parallel GAS and custom copies.
phases.reopen_consumers: ABriarwakePlayerState; ABriarwakeCharacter; UActionExecutionComponent; WBP_HUD
phases.run_now: Attack the dummy with one client and then two. Disable damage notifies, introduce latency and verify the same server result. The fixture deals 20 damage per valid hit against 100 health.
phases.rejection: No stamina, stale target, blocked line of sight, double activation and a late hit from an old avatar are rejected under the defined command identity.
phases.regression: Rerun action arbitration: attacks cancel or reject fishing/interaction only according to policy. Movement and zone handoff must not duplicate ability grants.

phases.build_target: Enemy AI, aggro/leash, death/respawn, kill rewards and combat XP
phases.required_proof: Solo and two-client battle with real enemy grants XP once; no reward replay after restart
phases.title: Enemy, encounter death and XP
phases.editor_steps: Add ABriarwakeEnemy/AIController with the shared 2D walkability contract. Assign DA_Encounter_RoadAmbush, leash and telegraph data. Add a once-only XP reward through the existing durable receipt path; full item loot activates in Phase 11.
phases.native_contract: An encounter instance changes Alive → RewardPending → Rewarded. Participation is server-derived; support and damage credit use published eligibility, not last-hit ownership.
phases.reopen_consumers: L_ElderwoodRoad; ABriarwakeGameMode; UCombatAttributeSet; UCharacterStateComponent
phases.run_now: Defeat the road ambush alone and with two clients. Check 25 fixture XP once per eligible character; reconnect and reenter without repeating the old reward.
phases.rejection: Repeated death callback, late projectile, leash reset and disconnect during reward confirmation do not mint duplicate XP. Wipe recovery retains durable quest/project state.
phases.regression: Run Slice A only after all Phase 00–10 gates are actually passed: creator, village, second zone, combat, remote appearance, reconnect and durable XP.

phases.build_target: Item definitions, bags, equipment, paper-doll rendering, random weighted loot and consumables
phases.required_proof: Loot, equip/unequip, appearance, stat rebuild and reconnect work with no duplicate item instances
phases.title: Inventory, equipment and weighted loot
phases.editor_steps: Create the item/loot definitions and fifteen-slot enum, then wire inventory/equipment/loot screens to UCharacterStateComponent. Assign starter item definitions through DA_GameCatalog. Add owned instance IDs and explicit one/two-hand conflict rules.
phases.native_contract: Inventory and loadout revisions commit together where required. Item definitions are immutable; equipped slot values reference owned instances. Rebuild GAS equipment effects from the committed loadout.
phases.reopen_consumers: WBP_HUD; WBP_Inventory; WBP_Equipment; UCharacterAppearanceComponent; RoadAmbush reward consumer
phases.run_now: Loot, stack, split, equip, use and reconnect. Compare public appearance with private inventory and inspect weighted drop frequencies in a separate deterministic test harness.
phases.rejection: Full bag, wrong slot, negative amount, unowned instance and duplicate corpse claim fail without partial loss. An unsupported overlay uses the documented whole-outfit fallback.
phases.regression: Retest combat costs and damage after repeated equip/unequip and reconnect; no accumulated duplicate effect handles.

phases.build_target: Combat disciplines and talents, vocation model/mastery and initial vocation UI/skill trees
phases.required_proof: Valid skill purchase persists; class and vocation XP remain separate; dead-end prerequisite rejected
phases.title: Combat talents and vocation mastery
phases.editor_steps: Author discipline definitions and talent branches, keeping combat XP, vocation XP and reputation distinct. Add profession/talent screens and prerequisite validation. Bind the three prototype vocations to starter/mastery objectives; later vocation routes activate at 20/21.
phases.native_contract: Skill purchases remain service-backed transactions over authored prerequisites and separate combat/mastery budgets. Bind each character to its permanently selected UCombatDisciplineDefinition; respec stays within that class. Derive combat/vocation levels independently from validated XP definitions. Restore saved vocation records without re-awarding points; never infer mastery from animation counts.
phases.reopen_consumers: WBP_CharacterCreate; WBP_Professions; WBP_Talents; UCharacterStateComponent; GAS grant consumer
phases.run_now: With the approved faction catalog and discipline definitions integrated, rerun real character creation. Compare every available class/vocation combination; inspect independent levels and retained histories. At Phase 13 connect trainer interaction to ChangeVocation, then run Fixture_identity including Level 35 Vanguard / Level 20 Forgekeeper → new Level 1 Hearthkeeper → Level 12 Hearthkeeper → restored Forgekeeper 20 → restored Hearthkeeper 12.
phases.rejection: Reject post-creation CombatDisciplineId mutation, combat/mastery point substitution, overspending, exclusive branches, cyclic prerequisites, duplicate purchase and inactive-vocation abilities/recipes. Never present another class selector as respec or retraining.
phases.regression: Rerun baseline combat with each art-supported starting discipline. Arcanist/Warden art gaps remain explicit rather than disappearing from scope.

phases.build_target: NPC dialogue, quest objectives/journal, starter quest chain, vocation mentor contracts
phases.required_proof: Character completes one multi-step quest alone; joining mid-quest never double-grants reward
phases.title: Starter quests, mentors and baseline NPC commerce
phases.editor_steps: Author First Supplies and Mentor Vesa using composable NPC service definitions. Add journal/dialogue observers. Introduce only fixed baseline repair/supply/commission services needed for the starter slice; retain Phase 25 for full stock, bank and secure trade. Faction extension: Extend existing NPC/quest definitions and evaluate one faction access decision. Author Vesa plus Maren/Talan/Eren and Q1–Q3 while retaining First Supplies. No project or later recipe is required by these early quests.
phases.native_contract: Quest objectives consume authoritative gameplay receipts, not widgets. NPC services share the existing command route. Route the existing trainer service through ChangeVocation with lease/revision checks and the established provisional retraining policy; no new trainer class or transaction owner. Separate CombatXP and targeted VocationXP awards in the atomic quest reward. Reuse the existing authenticated character/quest/region/lease owners; no faction runtime package is delivered in mmo_docs.
phases.reopen_consumers: ANpcServiceActor; WBP_Dialogue; WBP_QuestJournal; WBP_Merchant; DA_GameCatalog; UNpcServiceDefinition; ANpcServiceActor; UQuestDefinition; DA_GameCatalog; WBP_Dialogue
phases.run_now: Accept and complete the existing starter chain alone through its current alternatives. At an appropriate existing trainer, run Fixture_identity with introduction/varied-contract requirements satisfied and the authored retraining fee policy configured. Revisit trained vocations, retry an accepted change and verify no duplicated kit, mastery points, recipes or modifiers. Faction acceptance: Run oath/caravan/parley alternatives alone; reject client evidence and NPC hostility in the neutral square.
phases.rejection: Stale dialogue, ineligible quest, duplicate delivery and unavailable service retain their existing errors. Trainer changes additionally reject stale lease/revision, unavailable vocation, incomplete trade/craft/transfer or unresolved durable work; no partial fee or progress mutation.
phases.regression: Run combat → loot → vendor → journal from the normal route. A conversation may limit local input but must not pause the server.

phases.build_target: Eligible randomized ore/tree/plant/salvage sites, server harvest and respawn
phases.required_proof: Solo gather progresses; two clients cannot both claim exclusive site; dense-region spawn remains walkable
phases.title: Eligible resource sites and harvest races
phases.editor_steps: Place authored ore/tree/plant/salvage candidates with stable IDs, spacing and collision checks. Assign UResourceSiteDefinition policies and persist depletion/generation. Connect gathering through UActionExecutionComponent and the existing inventory/receipt transaction.
phases.native_contract: Acquire a bounded claim, validate again at completion, and atomically grant material/mastery plus depletion state. The client sends target/action intent, not a desired resource count.
phases.reopen_consumers: L_ElderwoodRoad; UActionExecutionComponent; UCharacterStateComponent; WBP_Professions
phases.run_now: Harvest a valid vein solo, then race two clients against the exclusive fixture. At most one current-generation claim succeeds; reconnect before respawn and inspect unchanged depletion.
phases.rejection: Invalid tool, expired claim, blocked site, full bag and rapid repeated commands reject. Ensure a losing contender receives a viable alternative route rather than indefinite starvation.
phases.regression: Rerun path/collision tests after randomized selection and verify essential doors/water exits remain clear.

phases.build_target: Forgekeeper complete mini-loop: prospect, recover salvage, smelt/forge, repair, defend
phases.required_proof: Solo plays Forgekeeper outing plus one world-project material, gear usable and restart-safe
phases.title: Forgekeeper outing and first durable project contribution
phases.editor_steps: Add WatchFitting recipe and forge service. Build the small North Road project schema, board and record now because this phase requires a real repair outcome. Connect prospect → salvage encounter → harvest → forge → watchtower contribution. Faction extension: Retain early project board and one region owner. Prepare faction-neutral bound work receipts alongside the existing Forgekeeper fitting route; do not claim the full campaign or all five recipes exist.
phases.native_contract: Crafting and contribution share receipt/transaction primitives. The early project is not a debug counter: debit inputs, record contribution and publish stage once. Expand this same owner/schema at 22/23. Reuse the existing authenticated character/quest/region/lease owners; no faction runtime package is delivered in mmo_docs.
phases.reopen_consumers: WBP_Crafting; WBP_RegionBoard; ARegionProjectionActor; DA_Project_NorthRoad; DA_Quest_FirstSupplies; DA_Project_NorthRoad; Record_Region; ProjectContributionRecord; WBP_RegionBoard
phases.run_now: As a solo Forgekeeper obtain 3 ore and 1 salvage plate, forge one fitting and contribute it. Inspect inventory debit, mastery and region receipt; restart and observe the repair state. Faction acceptance: One character can contribute through basic work; race duplicate source IDs and existing NorthRoad alias.
phases.rejection: Double-click craft, replay contribution, lose response after commit and fill inventory all have explicit outcomes. No animation completion may grant fitting or stage credit.
phases.regression: Rerun vendor alternatives so another vocation can acquire essential fittings without a human blacksmith. Maintain the same catalog/region identities through later phases.

phases.build_target: Fishing water/pools, bite/catch/cancel, species tables and actual p3 sprite states
phases.required_proof: Solo catches fish exactly once per cast and animation/zone reset never duplicates catch
phases.title: Fishing and one catch per cast
phases.editor_steps: Author Reedbank pool and Reedfin species data, cast geometry, bite/reel states and accessible timing mode. Assign audited p3/rod poses only after source inspection. Connect cast intent through the shared action component.
phases.native_contract: The server owns CastId, bite timing, eligible outcome and catch receipt. Input accessibility changes the permitted interaction policy, not the writer of fish/XP.
phases.reopen_consumers: AFishingWater; WBP_Fishing; UCharacterAppearanceComponent; UActionExecutionComponent; DA_GameCatalog
phases.run_now: Catch a Reedfin, interrupt a second cast by movement and a third by zone transfer. Reconnect after a lost success response and observe one catch only.
phases.rejection: Stale bite, fake water, duplicate reel, dead character and full bag do not grant fish. Controller/audio-disabled modes retain a usable cue.
phases.regression: Rerun gathering and combat arbitration. A late fish timer cannot reopen an action after combat/transfer cancellation.

phases.build_target: Personal farming plots, planting/growth/harvest, ingredient production and cooked/baked food
phases.required_proof: Solo plants, fishes, bakes an expedition food item; no offline crop deletion or rival harvesting exploit
phases.title: Personal farm, ingredients and baking
phases.editor_steps: Assign one private plot, Goldenroot seed/crop and growth stages. Add the oven and FieldLoaf recipe linking fish and farm ingredients. Use a controlled test clock to inspect growth; ordinary UI actions still plant and harvest the plot.
phases.native_contract: Planting commits seed debit and plot state; harvesting commits yield and generation. Mature crops remain valid during absence. Timed visuals derive from server state.
phases.reopen_consumers: AFarmPlot; WBP_FarmPlot; ACraftingStation; WBP_Crafting; WBP_Fishing
phases.run_now: Plant, complete a fishing outing, harvest the ready test crop, bake FieldLoaf and reconnect. Repeat after a simulated server downtime interval.
phases.rejection: Rival harvest, duplicate planting, full inventory at harvest and unsupported crop migration preserve consistent ownership and ingredients.
phases.regression: Rerun Forgekeeper crafting and region debit tests because food now uses the same recipe/transaction machinery.

phases.build_target: Hearthkeeper full mini-loop, food provisioning contracts and variation
phases.required_proof: Solo reaches vocation advancement by mixing water/field/kitchen and an expedition objective
phases.title: Complete Hearthkeeper supply expedition
phases.editor_steps: Extend the mentor contract with fish → field → kitchen → caravan provisioning. Offer a menu choice between travel endurance and healing supplies. The calmer route provisions volunteers; the risk route accompanies the caravan defense.
phases.native_contract: Hearthkeeper mastery records accepted diverse objectives and production receipts, not repeated watering clicks. The project accepts the provision category without requiring another vocation online.
phases.reopen_consumers: DA_Vocation_Hearthkeeper; DA_Quest_FirstSupplies; WBP_Professions; WBP_RegionBoard
phases.run_now: Play the full loop as one human from login through provision credit, using at least three interaction types and a meaningful recipe decision. Reconnect after delivery.
phases.rejection: A duplicate delivery or reused fish catch cannot advance mastery twice. The NPC alternative prevents a missing weather ingredient from blocking the story.
phases.regression: Rerun the Forgekeeper route and map/merchant prerequisites. Slice B is deliberately not accepted until Wayfinder cartography at Phase 19.

phases.build_target: Wayfinder exploration/cartography, tracks, hidden routes and skirmish encounters
phases.required_proof: Solo scout discovers route and threat, fights, reports it, gains personal/shared discovery once
phases.title: Wayfinder cartography and revised Slice B checkpoint
phases.editor_steps: Add personal discovery cells, track/clue definitions, hidden Willow Cut and a shared shortcut state. Wire map/minimap, the route NPC report and skirmish/safer investigation alternatives. Faction extension: Preserve Slice B here. Wayfinder discovery receipts may contribute to the same project; faction badge does not gate cartography.
phases.native_contract: Personal discovery, optional first-arrival recognition and shared route access are separate transactions/scopes. Revealing a public shortcut does not consume another character’s personal reward. Reuse the existing authenticated character/quest/region/lease owners; no faction runtime package is delivered in mmo_docs.
phases.reopen_consumers: DA_Vocation_Wayfinder; WBP_WorldMap; WBP_Minimap; AZoneGate; ARegionProjectionActor; CharacterDiscoveryRecord; DA_Project_NorthRoad
phases.run_now: Inspect three clues, choose a route, overcome its challenge, report and use the shortcut. Rejoin and replay triggers without another reward. Now run all three Slice B vocation routes. Faction acceptance: Run existing Slice B and reject duplicate discovery/contribution credit.
phases.rejection: Client-forged discovery, wrong clue order, invalid gate and duplicate report reject. A later-arriving character can still complete the personal route.
phases.regression: Revised Slice B is after Phase 19, not 18. Its merchant/board minimum was introduced at 13/15; full economy and regional extensions remain later.

phases.build_target: Woodwright timber management, carpentry, replanting, defense assets and quests
phases.required_proof: Solo sources eligible timber, crafts a bridge support and restores an authored forest/road state
phases.title: Woodwright timber, carpentry and grove restoration
phases.editor_steps: Activate DA_Vocation_Woodwright, BridgeSupport recipe and mentor route. Use existing sites for eligible mature timber, authored replant/restore states and defense objectives. Add necessary tool/art fallbacks transparently. Faction extension: Author structural timber item/site on existing resource/inventory owners and bind the Woodwright recipe input. Preserve server-randomized eligible sites and neutral safe access.
phases.native_contract: The Woodwright composes shared gathering, crafting, quest and project systems. Sustainable selection and support design change the outcome; no independent logging inventory subsystem.
